tw-ia-dubuque-kelly-bluff.st: Laird (1927) repeats the local account that about 1868 a boy found $3,300 in gold eagles in cans at Kelly's old cabin.

tw-ia-steamboat-rock-gold-digging.t: Laird (1927) also lists caves below Steamboat Rock as a hideout of the Bunker / Rainsbarger horse-thief gang of Hardin County, named only; no cache claim.
